items.headline: Public sector unions to strike Monday
items.summary: Unions covering education, health, administration and development officers say they will strike on November 30 despite government appeals, seeking a Rs. 25,000 interim allowance and fixes to salary anomalies. Teachers and principals plan to report sick, which may disrupt school exams.

items.headline: Arrests over Prabhakaran photo displays
items.summary: Public Security Minister Ananda Wijepala told Parliament that people were arrested in Mannar and Mullaitivu for displaying images of the late LTTE leader at remembrance events. He said remembering dead relatives is allowed but promoting the banned LTTE is not, and that old overseas photos are circulating online as recent.

items.headline: Parliament passes Defence Ministry budget head
items.summary: The Defence Ministry's expenditure head was approved 85 to 4 during the budget committee stage, with 139 MPs absent.

items.headline: Two expressway sections start construction Dec 1
items.summary: The Transport Minister said work begins on December 1 on the Kurunegala–Galewela stretch of the Central Expressway and the Kahathuduwa–Ingiriya first phase of the Ruwanpura Expressway. Studies are also underway on an Anuradhapura-centred network and an extension of the Katunayake expressway to Chilaw.

items.headline: Faiszer warns on terrorism Bill definition
items.summary: MP Faiszer Musthapha urged the government to rethink the proposed Protection of the State from Terrorism Bill, saying its definition could reach dissent, trade unions, journalists and lawyer-client privilege. He welcomed plans for wider consultation.

items.headline: Vijitha Herath meets Modi in New Delhi
items.summary: The Foreign Minister met Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi with other IORA ministers on the sidelines of the 25th IORA Council of Ministers meeting.

items.headline: Suspected drug dinghy seized off Mirissa
items.summary: The Navy and Coast Guard seized a dinghy believed to be carrying narcotics off Thalaramba beach. No one was detained and the boat is being brought ashore for investigation.

items.headline: 827 kg of Kendu leaves seized in Kalpitiya
items.summary: A Navy–Police raid in Pudukudiyirippu recovered 22 sacks of smuggled Kendu leaves and a vehicle, and arrested one suspect.

items.headline: Blast near Afghan school kills 10 students
items.summary: An explosion in Asadabad, Kunar province, killed at least 10 students and injured over 100. Officials blamed careless handling of explosives used for mining.

items.headline: 14 dead on migrant boat off Canary Islands
items.summary: Fourteen people were found dead on a boat carrying about 100 migrants south of El Hierro, as crossings surge ahead of Spain's election.
